neighbours.label: function word (the/a/an/and) at the slot before the next scenery word in old-fashioned picturesque description of landscape or buildings ('in ⟦the⟧ heavens', 'with ⟦a⟧ lofty spire')
fire: The abbey is a venerable ruin of red sandstone, seated in a sheltered hollow and shaded with a grove of ancient elms.
Not a breath stirred the leaves, and the evening star shone with a mild and tranquil lustre in the western sky.
The castle occupies a bold promontory, and commands an extensive view of the firth and the distant mountains.
A few fleecy clouds lingered in the heavens, tinged with the last rosy light of the departing sun.
The hamlet lies in a fertile dale, watered by a clear stream which winds among meadows and hanging woods.
The parish church is an elegant structure in the Gothic style, with a square tower and a peal of six bells.
Beyond the lawn the eye wandered over a rich and varied landscape, bounded by a chain of blue hills.
The road descends through a narrow and thickly-wooded ravine, at the bottom of which a torrent foams over the rocks.
quiet: The printer is a compact unit of grey plastic, placed in a corner and connected with a short cable.
Not a single invoice was missing, and the auditor signed the report with a blue pen in the afternoon.
The company occupies a rented floor, and holds a weekly meeting of the sales and the support teams.
A few stray emails lingered in the inbox, flagged with the red label of the billing department.
The database lives in a remote cluster, backed up by a script which runs among the nightly jobs.
The mobile app is a simple tool in the freemium style, with a login screen and a list of six tabs.
After the lunch the talk moved over a long and boring agenda, closed by a round of quick votes.
The patch goes through a strict and fully-automated pipeline, at the end of which a bot posts the results.

notes: Card: ' the' x13 after in/with in 19th-century scenic prose. Probes: scenic sentences 0.11-0.33 of max, modern/technical sentences with the same function words 0.00-0.03. Fire level is modest, so the median may sit near the 0.20 bar.
